title: Section 5 — Extension of prescribed period in certain cases — Limitation Act 1963

content.heading: Extension of prescribed period in certain cases
content.text: Any appeal or any application, other than an application under any of the provisions of Order XXI of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, may be admitted after the prescribed period, if the appellant or the applicant satisfies the Court that he had sufficient cause for not preferring the appeal or making the application within such period.
